transcription.text: Hi, I just thought I'd show you this for the last time. This is the old EEVblog garage lab.
This is where it all started. The original benches are still there. And for those who remember,
there was a bench that also came out here over the car bonnet because we didn't have enough room back
then. But yeah, it's all still there. But it is coming down today because we're going to get rid
of, I think we're going to get rid of that supplemental bench there. And the original
main workbench is actually going to, is moving, oriented that way and is going to go and be bolted
against the wall in there to give us some more space. But I just thought I'd show you one last
garage lab. And it's got my old, these are all custom made cabinets, which I made. I made all
those custom made cabinets and the shelving. Well, they're not, they're not very impressive,
the shelving, but yeah, some remnants of the original lights are still there. And yeah,
the original power strips and some of the stuff is still there. And this wasn't, this is after I
moved the lab and got the,

the new, you know, the new commercial office space. I actually converted this into it. It did have a panel on the end. I've just taken that off today. And yeah, we converted that into just some cupboards where we store various stuff. But yeah, that's it. Historical landmark is coming down, I guess. But I thought I'd show you it for the one last time. Catch you next time.
